newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Rubber Belt takes over Tianhua Rubber.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Rubber Belt takes over Tianhua Rubber.

text.p: Shanghai Rubber Belt has taken over Shanghai Tianhuan Rubber Factory, a bankrupt enterprise, for 12.54 million yuan, a company statement said on Wednesday.
Shanghai Rubber Belt has been allowed to take over 3,159 square metres of land owned by Tianhua but does not have to take responsibility for its debts, the statement said.

Tianhua Rubber will continue its operations with total staff numbers cut from 294 to 190. Alternative arrangements will be made for the remaining staff members by Shanghai Rubber Belt, the statement added.
The statement forecast that Tianhua would have turnover of 18 million yuan and net profits of 800,000 yuan in 1997, offsetting cumulative losses of 8.554 million yuan up to the end of June this year.
